hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.gd) $HOME/.qoder/gdtools/bin/gdformat "$f" 2>&1 | head -2 >&2;; esac; }; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.gd) godot --headless --check-only --script "$f" 2>&1 | grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error' | head -5 >&2;; esac; }; exit 0
